recentItems.title: Partidul, Ceaușescu, Viitorul - The Party, Ceaușescu, the Future (Romanian Communist Song)
recentItems.description: Romanian communist song dedicated to president Nicolae Ceaușescu. Music by: Radu Paladi. Lyrics by: Dan Rotaru.

recentItems.title: Марш Второй Бригады - March of the Second Brigade (Soviet song)
recentItems.description: This is the russian version of the albanian partisan song "March of the 2nd Shock Brigade". Song performed by the Alexandrov Ensemble.

recentItems.title: Lied der Arbeiterbataillone - Song of the Workers' Battalions (East German communist song)
recentItems.description:
East German song dedicated to the Combat Groups of the Working Class (Kampfgruppen der Arbeiterklasse).

The Combat Groups of the Working Class was a paramilitary organization in the German Democratic Republic. Composed of members of the Socialist Unity Party of Germany and under the command of the Party, the organization was established as a popular defense force against counter-revolutionary elements, saboteurs and to engage in guerrilla warfare in case of a foreign invasion.

Lyrics by Toni Kohlsdorf. Music by Heinz Arenz. Performed by the Choir of the GDR Republic Ensemble.

recentItems.title: Tito nek' vodi nas - Let Tito lead us (Yugoslav communist song)
recentItems.description: Yugoslav song dedicated to Marshal Josip Broz Tito. Music by Milan Sachs.

recentItems.title: Albanian Military Parade - November 29th, 1979 | Parada Ushtarake Shqiptare - 29 Nëntor, 1979
recentItems.description:
The newsreel "Feston Shqiperia Socialiste" (Socialist Albania Celebrates) brings the celebrations held in Albania for the 35th anniversary of the albanian liberation in WW2.

The military parade was held on the Boulevard of the Martyrs of the Nation (Dëshmorët e Kombit Boulevard) and was followed by a civilian demonstration.

recentItems.title: Partidul sub un steag unind poporul - The Party under one flag uniting the people
recentItems.description:
Romanian communist song dedicated to the Romanian Communist Party.

Lyrics by Victor Tulbure. Music by Marius Țeicu.

recentItems.title: Und alle singen mit - And everyone sings along (East German song)
recentItems.description: East German military song performed by the Erich-Weinert-Ensemble. Lyrics by Siegfried Berthold. Music by Kurt Greiner-Pol. From the album "In Warschau Beschlossen".

recentItems.title: Септемврийци - Septemberists (Bulgarian communist song)
recentItems.description:
Bulgarian song dedicated to the September Uprising of 1923, an armed insurgency staged by the Bulgarian Communist Party which aimed to overthrow Alexander Tsankov's government.

Lyrics by Hristo Karpachev.

recentItems.title: Песня единства - Song of Unity (Soviet song)
recentItems.description: Soviet communist song. Music: Boris Alexandrov. Lyrics: Alexander Godov. Performed by the Ensemble Alexandrov. Soloist: Vadim Ruslanov.

recentItems.title: Să fii Partidului oștean - To be a soldier of the Party (Romanian communist song)
recentItems.description: Romanian communist song. Music by Matei Socor. Lyrics by Mihai Beniuc. Soloist: Ladislau Konya.

recentItems.title: Kupředu, zpátky ni krok! - Forward, not a step back! (Czechoslovak communist song)
recentItems.description: Czechoslovak communist song. Music by Jan Seidel. Lyrics by Bedřich Bobek.
